detail: Today only the guard switch changes behavior (command log records while off; the digest and status for all layers). Memory filtering (SP-025), outbound terms (SP-044, SP-045), generated sandbox rules (SP-046) and the enforcing guard (SP-041, which must fail closed in enforcing states per INV-13 and needs the enforcement state in the read-only file it reads) must read enforcement.state for their layer when they land. The app's switches and banner are SP-072.
